purpose: A typed host readback for one Runtime delivery request, including explicit failure and unknown states.
rules: SUCCEEDED requires an opaque external_result_ref and no error code.
FAILED and UNKNOWN require a safe error code and never imply completion.
NO_EXTERNAL_ACTION is valid only for LOCAL_ONLY and cannot contain a Runtime request or external result.

Every external receipt must match request ID, request digest, choice digest, action, policy, adapter contract, source, environment, and Runtime reference; it cannot be accepted without the corresponding prepared adapter contract.
